facts.business: Seasons Textiles Limited manufactures furnishing fabrics, exports and trades in furnishing fabrics and made-ups, and operates an in-house design studio with over 25,000 designs.

segments.name: Furnishing fabrics manufacturing, export and trading

key_risks: Competition from unorganized sector in furnishing industry
Foreign currency risk due to export turnover and dealings in USD/EUR
Management risk including market-led business risk, financial risk, change of trends and designs, technology obsolescence, safety/health/environment risk, regulatory issues
Challenges in recruiting and retaining skilled personnel for rapid growth
